title: Unique Garlicky Argentinian Beef Wrap
description: A romantic Argentinian dish featuring garlicky beef, dried mint, and tempering chocolate, all wrapped in a lotus leaf.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, dried mint, salt, and black pepper.
Add the beef strips to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Wrap each beef strip in a lotus leaf, making sure to seal the edges.
Place the wrapped beef on a baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes.
Melt the tempering chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30 second increments.
Remove the beef from the oven and brush with the melted chocolate.
Return the beef to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
